name: BetterContact
description: Waterfall email & phone enrichment across 20+ providers. Async: enrich, then poll for the result.

methods.label: Enrich (submit)
methods.description: Submit up to 100 leads for waterfall email/phone enrichment. `data` is an array of leads, each with first_name, last_name, company, company_domain, linkedin_url (and optional custom_fields). Set enrich_email_address and/or enrich_phone_number. Returns { success, id } where `id` is the request id — poll Get Result with it. ASYNC: results are not ready immediately.

data.description: Array of leads (1-100). Each: { first_name, last_name, company, company_domain, linkedin_url, custom_fields }

enrich_email_address.description: Find a verified work email (default true)

webhook.description: Optional webhook URL POSTed when enrichment finishes

methods.label: Get Result (poll)
methods.description: Fetch enrichment results by request id (the `id` from Enrich). Returns { id, status, credits_consumed, credits_left, data[] } where status is 'pending' until done then 'terminated'. Each data item has contact_email_address, contact_email_address_status, contact_phone_number, contact_job_title, etc.

methods.label: Find Leads (submit)
methods.description: Submit a People/Company search to discover net-new leads (no input list). `filters` carries company criteria (company domains, company_industry, company_technology, company_headcount_min/max) and people criteria (lead_fullname, lead_linkedin_url, lead_department, lead_function, lead_skills, lead_job_title [+exact_match], lead_location, lead_seniority) — each an { include:[...], exclude:[...] } object. Returns { success, message, request_id } — poll Get Found Leads with request_id. ASYNC: results are not ready immediately.

filters.description: Company + people filter object (see description). Each people field is { include:[...], exclude:[...] }.

offset.description: Pagination offset; increase to page through results

webhook.description: Optional webhook URL POSTed when the search finishes

methods.label: Get Found Leads (poll)
methods.description: Fetch lead-finder results by request id (the `request_id` from Find Leads). Returns { id, status, credits_consumed, credits_left, summary:{ leads_found }, leads[] } where status is 'pending' until done then 'terminated'. Each lead has contact (name, job_title, seniority, linkedin_url, location, email, phone) + company (name, domain, industry, headcount, hq, founded) fields. Do NOT poll this with an Enrich id — use Get Result for those.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by Find Leads

methods.label: Check Credits
methods.description: Get the remaining credit balance for the account. Requires the account `email` as a query param (alongside the API key). Returns { success, credits_left, email }. Free — call before large enrichment or lead-finder batches.
